answer.summary: API types check failed because the committed openaev-front/src/utils/api-types.d.ts is out of sync with the types generated from the running API. The only diff is in ScenarioUpdateInput.scenario_update_choices, which the generator now wraps across lines. The failure is deterministic, so a re-run will fail again. Fix: run yarn generate-types-from-api locally against the change and commit the regenerated api-types.d.ts.
